leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a user interface with input fields and buttons for note creation and search
Implement state management to store and update an array of note objects
Configure event handlers to add new notes and delete existing notes
Manipulate the DOM to render the current list of notes dynamically
Integrate a search input to filter the displayed notes based on user input
Initialize a form to edit note content and update the state accordingly
Apply conditional rendering to show edit forms only for selected notes
lessonTitle: Build a notes app with create edit delete and search
